That is not a command patchy knows.

Commands go on the first line of a comment. Here you can use:

- `/patchy approve`: approve the posted plan and start the build
- `/patchy replan [note]`: plan again, taking the note and approvers' comments since the last plan into account
- `/patchy cancel`: stop work on this intent and close it; open pull requests are left to you
